title: feat(plugin-audit): a credential_use ledger row when an API key or OAuth token is used
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9PUSFTyQBsLErJg9ThNH59B)_

Fixes #31796

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Measured values: `sys_audit_log.action` is plugin-audit's own `Field.select` option set (readonly, not a `packages/spec` enum), so the new `credential_use` value widens that set and changes no metadata surface; no `packages/spec` file is touched. Seat ruling on the card: Shape A, `yes (widening)`, `none`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:API key 或 OAuth 访问令牌被使用时，在既有的「每凭据每小时一次」`last_used_at` 打点那一刻，向 `sys_audit_log` 写一行 `credential_use`(主体、凭据 id、种类、组织、时间);`skip_consent` 的 OAuth 客户端没有 consent 行，改由 plugin-auth 在同一打点处按(client, user)每小时交给审计槽一次。
- **为什么改**:凭据放行此前不留任何审计痕迹，SIEM(cloud#3665)看不到哪把 key / 哪个令牌在被谁使用。
- **风险与回滚**:放行代码一行未动，审计写在 `afterUpdate` 里且永不抛出，CONTROL 钉住放行判定、解析出的上下文和打点行在有无审计时逐字节一致;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/credential-use-audit.ts`(识别打点、拼行、写入),再看 `plugin-auth/src/mcp-client-last-use.ts` 的 `handOffConsentlessUse`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd packages/plugins/plugin-audit && pnpm exec vitest run src/credential-use-audit.integration.test.ts`(12/12),`cd packages/plugins/plugin-auth && pnpm exec vitest run src/mcp-client-last-use.real-engine.test.ts`(16/16)。
- **需要你做的**:无;IP 与 UA 暂为空，跟进卡 #31821。

## What changes

- **plugin-audit** gains a `credential_use` writer (`credential-use-audit.ts`). An `afterUpdate` hook on `sys_api_key` and `sys_oauth_consent` recognises the existing throttled last-use stamp by its changed fields (only `last_used_at`, plus `expires_at` on a key; the `isSignInStamp` precedent) and writes one row from the stored record: `user_id` / `actor`, `record_id` = credential id, `object_name`, `tenant_id` = the credential's organization, and `metadata` `{ credential_kind: api_key | oauth_access_token, credential_id, used_at, client_id (OAuth) }`. The window is the stamp's own interval and decision point, so there is no second timer: one row per credential per window. The row never carries the key, the token, the stored hash or a prefix.
- The `audit` service slot gains `recordCredentialUse(event)`, validated (kind must match the object; credential id and principal required), written in system context, failures reported once per cause at `error` and never thrown. The persist callee `persistCredentialUseAuditRow` is registered as durability-critical in `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` and `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`.
- **plugin-auth**: a `skip_consent` OAuth client has no consent row, so its use was never stamped and left no trace. `McpClientLastUseStamper` now, at the same stamp point and inside the same per-(client, user, org) hourly memo, hands such a use to the audit slot once per hour (`onConsentlessUse` → `recordCredentialUse` with `sys_oauth_application` and the application id). This uses an optional member on plugin-auth's local structural audit surface; no spec contract changes.
- `sys_audit_log.action` gains the option `credential_use` ("Credential Use"), writer-first; translation bundles regenerated.
- Every door counts because every door reaches the one key-admission stamp: REST, the runtime dispatcher including `/mcp`, stdio MCP (per call), and storage. OAuth tokens are admitted only on the `/mcp` HTTP door, whose stamp is plugin-auth's.

## Why

An API key or OAuth access token admitting a request wrote no `sys_audit_log` row, so the ledger could not say which credential acted for whom.

## Verification

- `plugin-audit` `src/credential-use-audit.integration.test.ts`: real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AuditPlugin` over SQLite, the platform's own identity objects, admissions driven through the real `@objectstack/core` calls each door makes. 12/12. Pins: one row per key naming principal and key id; seven admissions in one window write one row and the first after the window writes the second; no secret, hash or prefix anywhere in the row; REST, `/mcp`, stdio and storage each count; an org-less key writes `tenant_id` null; a non-stamp update writes nothing; the consent's hourly stamp writes one row with `client_id`; a `skip_consent` hand-off writes one row, a mismatched kind or unknown object nothing; **CONTROL**: admission verdict, resolved context and stamped key row are byte-identical with and without the ledger, and the ledger never makes the stamp fail.
- `plugin-auth` `src/mcp-client-last-use.real-engine.test.ts`: 16/16, including 25 calls of a `skip_consent` client in one hour → one hand-off and zero consent writes, the next hour one more, and a consent client hands nothing on.
- Ablations (each mutation applied with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, red shown, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): write removed → 9 red; the core stamp interval forced open → window pin and CONTROL red; the stamp-field filter removed → non-stamp pin red; the row fed the stored record → no-secret pin red (hash found); hook throws → CONTROL red (stamp failure logged); ledger touching the key → CONTROL red (verdict changes); `skip_consent` hand-off removed → its pin red.
- Full suites on the merged head: plugin-audit 80/80 files, 1237/1237 tests; plugin-auth 248/248 files, 4440 passed, 10 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck`, same for plugin-auth: exit 0. ESLint over both packages and the two scripts: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on head `03f6f671`: 127 derived, 127 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

**Forced test edits** (existing files): `sys-audit-log-retired-actions.test.ts` (`credential_use` added to `ACTIONS_WITH_WRITERS`) and `sys-audit-log-action-labels.test.ts` (value appended) — the writer-first pins every new action value must update; `mcp-client-last-use.real-engine.test.ts` `rig()` gains an optional `getAuditSink` so the new case can observe the hand-off (no existing case changed).

**Deviation from the claimed surface**: `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` and `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` each gain the new persist callee; the tenant-audit census (`content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`) recounted for the one new system-context write site (276 → 277).

**Acceptance notes**

- `ip_address` and `user_agent` are null on this row: neither stamp point holds the client address (core admission sees headers only, no peer address or `trustProxy`; stdio has none; the OAuth stamp seam carries the principal only). Follow-up: #31821.
- The CRUD mirror still writes its own unattributed `update` row for each stamp, as before this change (code read, not changed here).
- A held key (refused at a lifecycle gate) is still stamped by core, so it also writes a `credential_use` row.
- The window is per stored stamp: several processes passing the stored-row check in the same instant may each write one row for that window; a `skip_consent` client's memo is per process, so at most one row per process per hour.

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
